title: Yes, Life Isn’t Fair
coreMove: Admit life dealt you a worse card and stop scoring yourself against it, and the energy envy was eating comes back for the hand you actually hold.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Sawyer and Kendall body comparison
exampleSpecs.audience: Yuki and readers facing comparison as torture
exampleSpecs.stakes: Reassurance cannot cure comparison that is attached to an unchangeable scorecard.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Yuki using comparison as torture in the source case without controlling another person.

exampleSpecs.audience: Zain and readers facing comparison as torture
exampleSpecs.stakes: Acceptance of unequal starting points can coexist with skillful action.
